description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named `GeneralTab` which displays a list of news articles, including top headlines carousel and general news list, with loading indicators and navigation to detailed articles.

classes.name: GeneralTab
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying top headlines in a carousel and general news list with refresh capability.
